_comment: Two VENDOR files inside a source archive, each naming the same file with a different source. An XPI can only be told to keep one of them. An archive is told not to carry the library at all - declare it in package.json and let the build copy it - which makes the ambiguity moot, so this pins a remedy that differs in substance from its XPI twin. The XPI here also ships two VENDOR files of its own, which in a source-code submission belongs in the archive - the copy the reviewer reads and the build installs from - so sca-not-required warns that this did not need to be a source submission. It is advice about the NEXT one and narrows nothing here.
